description:
Find Smartpress products matching a name or description. Returns matching products with their id, name, and description (plus group, link, image and a relevance score).

Only products that can be configured through this assistant are returned. If nothing fits, say so and point the customer to smartpress.com rather than suggesting a product from memory.

Use this to discover products by what the user is trying to print (e.g. "saddle stitch booklet", "matte business cards"). Take the "id" of the best match (e.g. "SLS_7") and pass it to create_config_session as productId to configure the product, then add_to_cart.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 10).

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "saddle stitch booklet" or "matte business cards".

name: find_products
